g.text: Reusable fixed-N13 models: exact CPU compilation beats frozen GPU sampling

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Two-family 10× speed claim: SUPPORTED · compilation and independent completeness verification included

text.style: font-size: 10.9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Same frozen BP AdamW models; two fresh 4,096-input cohorts; three query/search seeds and 20 outputs per input

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: CPU time = model checks + enumeration + independent proof + cache serialization/load + three query calls.

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: The dashed timing marks are GPU time divided by 10. GPU numerator includes three complete synchronized solve calls.

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Warmups, scoring and record serialization are outside the compared solve calls; all GPU worker costs remain charged to the study.

text.style: font-size: 10.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #444444

g.text: Full GPU-worker cost: 269.95s. Cache sizes: 2,696 and 6,368 solutions. Query workers read clue-only files.

g.text: The exact quality result follows complete zero-F enumeration and validity; the measured speed threshold is the falsifiable endpoint.
